title: Trump-backed candidate wins high-stakes GOP primary for New Hampshire battleground district
summary: Donald Trump endorsed Anthony DiLorenzo defeated Novel Iron Works owner Hollie Noveletsky and state Rep. Brian Cole to clinch the GOP nomination for the Granite State's 1st Congressional District.

title: Incumbent GOP governor rolls to primary victory after keeping Trump at a distance
summary: Kelly Ayotte cruised past Republican primary challengers, setting up a high-stakes New Hampshire governor's race against Democrat Cinde Warmington.

title: South Park creators mock Trump's Lake Ontario rename and company compliance in mock statement
summary: Trey Parker and Matt Stone announced "South Park" will be renamed "South America" Tuesday in a jab at Apple Maps and Google Maps over the Lake Ontario name change.

title: Trump's unusual role at midterm convention revealed as schedule goes public
summary: Trump headlines both nights of the RNC's first-ever GOP midterm convention in Dallas, with JD Vance delivering the Thursday keynote speech.

title: Trump posthumously awards Medal of Freedom to 9/11's 'man in red bandana'
summary: President Donald Trump awards the Presidential Medal of Freedom posthumously to Welles Crowther, the heroic "man in the red bandana" who saved up to 18 lives during the September 11 attacks.

title: Massive alligator attacks young swimmer in nature preserve despite posted warning
summary: A 9-to-12-foot alligator bit a young swimmer at Weeki Wachee Preserve in a no-swimming zone in Florida, leaving the group stranded on a sandbar in the water.

title: Wife of top ex-Biden advisor easily advances to House showdown in November
summary: Maggie Goodlander faced challenger Paige Beauchemin in the New Hampshire Democratic primary as the district braces for a reshaped political map.

title: Ex-NFL star believes Mike McDaniel's 'best decision of his career' was joining Chargers with Justin Herbert
summary: Shawne Merriman said Mike McDaniel's explosive scheme could unlock a new gear for Justin Herbert and the Los Angeles Chargers' playoff hopes.

title: Cold case takes grim turn after remains identified as runaway teen; homicide investigation underway
summary: Advanced DNA testing and genetic genealogy identified remains found near a North Carolina manufacturing facility as those of a Maryland teen who vanished in 1977.

title: Establishment Dem defeats socialist challenger in crucial battleground Senate primary
summary: Chris Pappas defeated Karishma Manzur in the New Hampshire Senate primary, but a heated general election awaits against a former U.S. senator.
